happenings.name: Invading Sylviculture
happenings.sub:
A World Seedling causes forests to spread.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STARSEEDS_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Grasping Vines[/hyperlink] is active in combat.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STARSEEDS_PROPERTY_GROUP]Living Forest[/hyperlink] affects units on forest provinces.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Forests start to spread into adjacent provinces.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STARSEEDS_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Grasping Vines[/hyperlink] active in combat.</bullet><bullet>Units on Forest provinces suffer from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STARSEEDS_PROPERTY_GROUP]Living Forest[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: When a great World Tree has sufficiently matured, it shoots its seeds off into the Astral Sea towards new worlds.

World Trees do not reproduce on their own worlds. Instead, they spread their seeds on distant realms. Should a World Seed find a barren world, it will eventually make it fertile and inhabitable. However, a World Seed finding a lush world will stir the trees and plants that were already there.
Fragments of the shattered world have crashed in every forest, causing them to spread and grow hostile towards your armies.

events.label: End
text: After a period of upheaval, a World Seedling from a distant world has taken root, spawning a new this realm.

Peace returns within the realm and balance is restored, as is Nature's wont. Your troops may once again traverse the woodlands safely and unhindered. Yet for all the turmoil the World Seedling caused, you may have an opportunity to benefit from the woody incursion.
Will you restore your lands claimed by forests? Or is it more appealing to learn new power over nature?

options.text: Banish <mana></mana> the invading Forests and revert your provinces to their original terrains.
Learn <eventColor>Enchantment</eventColor> to have plants aid you in battle.
The forests are here to stay, yielding us timber. <structureprod></structureprod>
No forests grow in your domain.

happenings.name: Portent of Rousing
happenings.sub:
Units benefit from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.XORN_JAVELIN_GROUP]Portent of Rousing[/hyperlink].
Cities gain +100% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] income.
At the end of the happening, gain 20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] for each unit in your empire.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] is reduced by up to -50%.</bullet><bullet>Cities gain +100% <unitprod></unitprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>At the end of the happening, gain 20 <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] for each unit in your empire.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: Sightings have been reported of Xorn's Javelin, a long-tailed comet that pierces brightly through the nightly sky.

Every time this comet passes by a world, its denizens are overcome with an uncanny urge to fight. Already, your <eventColor>race</eventColor> are ardently lining up to enlist! Meanwhile, your troops in the field are stirred by the omen and passionately fight for your cause, as if Xorn the Disciplined himself leads them.
A thirst for battle rouses your citizens, while your troops are inspired to fight for your cause, instead of your gold.

events.label: End
text: Xorn's Javelin has traveled out of your sight, and the eagerness for combat that gripped your <eventColor>race</eventColor> quickly evaporates.

But, just as the comet crosses the horizon, it issues one final burst of burning loyalty. Your citizens that cannot fight are inspired to contribute to your war efforts. For each warrior in your army, a donation is made in celebration of the glory of your rulership.
With your coffers replenished, the future looks bright. You cannot wait until Xorn's Javelin returns.

happenings.name: Rays of Winter
happenings.sub:
Arctic terrain slowly covers the land.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SOLAR_WINTER_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Arctic Blizzards[/hyperlink] is active in combat.
Units on Arctic provinces suffer from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SOLAR_WINTER_PROPERTY_GROUP]Rays of Winter[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Arctic terrain spreads around the world.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SOLAR_WINTER_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Arctic Blizzards[/hyperlink] active in combat.</bullet><bullet>Units on Arctic provinces suffer from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SOLAR_WINTER_PROPERTY_GROUP]Rays of Winter[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: A substantial celestial crystal is lining up with the sun, turning its light red as ruby and diminishing its heat.

The sun is still as bright as ever, but its rays no longer convey their comforting heat. As the welcome warmth withdraws from your realm, snow and ice change your lands to the Evercold. Your citizens seek shelter in their homes, but your troops suffer from sudden blizzards.
The sun's rays of winter disrupt your world. Snowstorms not only complicate combat, but also freeze the land.

events.label: End
text: Finally, the sun releases the cosmic crystal from its pull. Warm rays of sunlight wash over your domain.

Yet the otherworldly cold that affected your world is not easily dismissed. But while the icy plains of permafrost formed, your mages have studied the celestial object that caused the solar disruption. They ensure you they can harness some of the crystal's magical properties for your own benefit.
Will you drive back the snow that claimed your lands? Or will you draw power from the fleeting rays of winter?

options.text: Thaw the snow with your inner magical fire. <mana></mana>
Learn the power of <eventColor>Enchantment</eventColor> from the retreating winter.
Apply the clarity offered by the cold to gain new insights. <knowledge></knowledge>
Fortunately, the winter never invaded your territory.

happenings.name: Phase-shift Nixing
happenings.sub:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PHASE_TELEPORT]Phasing units[/hyperlink] suffer from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PHASE_SHIFT_NIXING_GROUP]Phase-shift Nixing[/hyperlink].
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.TELEPORTER] Teleporters[/hyperlink] and teleporting spells and abilities are disabled.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Teleporter province improvements, Teleportation spells, and Teleportation abilities are disabled.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The recent visit of the <eventColor>Entity</eventColor> has stirred the cosmic cohesion of the firmament.

What is usually fleeting in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink], is now earthbound by the lingering aura of the <eventColor>Entity</eventColor>. The magic property of some particles that allows them to shift from substance into energy, is nullified.

Until the Sea can restore itself, the workings of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.TELEPORTER]<teleporter></teleporter> Teleporters[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PHASE]phase-shifters[/hyperlink] has been severely disrupted.

events.label: End
text: Finally, the comforting hums of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.TELEPORTER]<teleporter></teleporter> Teleporters[/hyperlink] fill the realm once more as their connections are restored.

But even while their abilities were disrupted, the teleporters continued to extract sublimated magic from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. With nowhere else to go, the magical energies were stored with these structures.
Deposits of suppressed magical energies are now suddenly released all at once, resulting in a snowfall of <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] crystals.

happenings.name: Starry-eyed Enlightenment
happenings.sub:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] income increased by +100%.
Declaring wars is always [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]unjust[/hyperlink].
Ending wars grants 200 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Cities gain +100% <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Declaring wars is always [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]unjust[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Ending wars grants 200 <influence></influence> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: Stargazers discover a new star in the sky. Dubbed "Gabriel's Eye," its gleam inspires all rulers to pursue knowledge.

Your scholars theorize that the recent disturbance of <eventColor>Constellation</eventColor> caused the new star to light up in the firmament. You discern within yourself a rising thirst for knowledge, while your hunger for battle wanes.
Will Gabriel's Eye bring about a new era of enlightenment, in which wisdom is valued over war? Time will tell.

events.label: End
text: As suddenly as it appeared, Gabriel's Eye is fading again, as are its pacifying effects.

You wonder if the ancient wizard had truly fixed its gaze on your world, or if this was a rumor produced by your people's superstition. However it may be, you cannot deny how its presence impacted the realm, pushing an era of enlightenment.
Slowly, the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] of this realm revert to their old, warring ways.

options.text: "The insolent warmongers of this realm must be held accountable."
"One way or another, this realm shall be mine."

happenings.name: Astral Eclipse
happenings.sub:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income reduced by -30%.
Combat and World Map Spells cost +50% Casting Points.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet><mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income is reduced by -30%.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink] cost +50% Casting Points.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: This night, the cries of scholars and mages echo throughout your realm: all the stars' lights have been snuffed!
No one comprehends what caused this event, yet your wizards and sorcerers inform you that they sense a dampening of their magical powers. You know they speak true: you felt it too.
All spellcasting and sources of magic are suppressed while the stars remain dimmed.

events.label: End
text: Behold! The stars are reignited one by one! The astral eclipse draws to an end.

Within a single night, all the constellations have returned to the firmament. In the distance, flashes of dazzling lights evidence the glee of your mages, who too have discovered the return of their powers.
A new age of wizarding and enchantment dawns. Let the magic flow freely from your fingers once again.

options.text: "My sorcerous spark returns at last."

happenings.name: Sign of the Cleft Shield
happenings.sub: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SIGN_OF_THE_CLEFT_SHIELD_PROPERTY_GROUP]Sign of the Cleft Shield[/hyperlink] affects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHIELD_UNIT]Shield Units[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHIELD_UNIT]Shield Units[/hyperlink] have:<bulletlist><bullet>Attacks deal +40% damage.</bullet><bullet>-4 <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The "shield" in the constellation of Baradir the Shield Master has broken in twain! Shields and bucklers everywhere spontaneously shatter.

Now that their full advantage of shield-wielding is lost, defenders are compelled to focus on their attacks. It is a formidable sight to behold: they strike harder and deeper, paying less heed to their defensive tactics.
The realm's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHIELD_UNIT]Shield Bearers[/hyperlink] may carry broken shields, but they are poised to thrash your enemies in the front lines.

events.label: End
text: The "shield" in the constellation of Baradir the Shield Master has restored itself. Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHIELD_UNIT]Shield Bearers'[/hyperlink] shields are equally mended.

Smiths and armorers repaired or reforged every broken targe and buckler in your realm. Defenders everywhere proudly bear their shields high once again. Having favored their sword-arm over their shields for so long, they reacquaint themselves with their familiar role as protectors.
Discounting the odd shield bash, this realm's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHIELD_UNIT]Shield Bearers[/hyperlink] once again favor defense over fierce attacks.

options.text: "You must train <unitprod></unitprod> your sword-arm even more."
"By my blood, my shield bearers may hold this starbound power."
"Protecting the meek is once more a shield-warrior's calling."

happenings.name: Sign of the Huntress
happenings.sub: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SIGN_OF_THE_HUNTRESS_PROPERTY_GROUP]Sign of the Huntress[/hyperlink] affects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RANGED_UNIT]Ranged Units[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mage Units[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SKIRMISHER]Skirmisher Units[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedConcept]Missile[/hyperlink] attacks of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RANGED_UNIT]Ranged Units[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mage Units[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SKIRMISHER]Skirmisher Units[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Deal +30% more damage.</bullet><bullet>Have -1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangeConcept]<range></range> Range[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: Complaints from your archers reach you. Their arrows seem weightier. Astrologers soon find the cause: the constellation of Leana's Draw has changed!

New stars have appeared around the "arrow" in the constellation of Leana's Draw. The celestial image now looks like the Huntress is drawing back a javelin on her bow. The alteration somehow affects not just your archers' arrows, but also the magical projectiles of your casters.

The constellation's new stars cosmically bolster the damage of this realm's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RANGED_UNIT]archers[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]casters[/hyperlink], at the cost of their range.

events.label: End
text: The additional stars in the constellation of Leana's Draw have dimmed again, much to the relief of your archers.

Your astrologers have several hypotheses concerning the cause of this alteration of the Sign of the Huntress, ranging from prophecies to divine intervention. Regardless, with the stars that elongated the "arrow" in the constellation gone, your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RANGED_UNIT]archers'[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]casters'[/hyperlink] natural range and damage are restored. They shake their weary arms and rejoice.
However, depending on how useful you found their temporary effectiveness, your archers' celebration could be premature.

options.text: "Instruct my mages to study <mana></mana> how to replicate this effect."
Perform a blood sacrifice to gain the enchantment.
"Let arrows fly far once more!"

happenings.name: Sign of the Lumbering Staff
happenings.sub: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SIGN_OF_THE_LUMBERING_STAFF_PROPERTY_GROUP]Sign Of The Lumbering Staff[/hyperlink] affects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mage Units[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]Support Units[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]Support Units[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mage Units[/hyperlink] have:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SupportConcept]Support[/hyperlink] abilities have +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangeConcept]<range></range> Range[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOW_MOVEMENT]Slow Movement[/hyperlink] in combat.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The star that represents the "staff gem" in the constellation of Anon's Ascent gleams as bright as the waxing moon.
Those who normally tend to the wounded or who empower warriors from afar, sense a hidden power burning inside them. They grow more potent, but the magnitude of their magical might weighs them down.

Proud [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]mages[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]healers[/hyperlink] stand taller than ever before, now that their power is surging. Their decreased speed clearly worries them not.

events.label: End
text: Your astrologers had already predicted it: the luminous star in Anon's Ascent returned to its original brightness.
While <eventColor>enemies</eventColor> wail about the loss of their powers, warriors are keen to point out that they have not disappeared, but merely returned to their original strength.

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Mages[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]soothers[/hyperlink] vainly inspect their hands, which yesterday wielded such great magical force. They lament their tempering. Do you?

options.text: "Keeping my mages empowered deserves a personal investment of magic." <mana></mana>
Perform a blood sacrifice to gain the enchantment.
"I favor their mobility returning. A slow mage is a dead mage."

happenings.name: Sign of the Vanguard
happenings.sub: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SIGN_OF_THE_VANGUARD_PROPERTY_GROUP]Sign Of The Vanguard[/hyperlink] affects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHOCK_UNIT]Shock Units[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHOCK_UNIT]Shock Units[/hyperlink] have:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VERY_FAST_MOVEMENT]Athletics[/hyperlink] in combat.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedConcept]Missile[/hyperlink] attacks against this unit have -20% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept]<accuracy></accuracy> Accuracy[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MeleeConcept]Melee[/hyperlink] attacks deal -20% damage.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: Half of the stars that make up the fabled great sword in the constellation of Ja'Vasqa's Charge have disappeared!

The nimble Tigran Warlord represented in the constellation now appears to brandish a short sword. Your warriors feel quickened by the cosmic phenomenon and report a surge in stamina and agility. They may move across the battlefield more deftly, at the expense of brute strength.
Even though their strikes inflict less damage, your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHOCK_UNIT]warriors[/hyperlink] will have no trouble meeting your enemies in combat.

options.text: "Charge forth on the wings of victory, my warriors!"

events.label: End
text: Ja'Vasqa's great sword has been celestially reforged. The stars have returned to complete the constellation.

Warriors leading the charge discover that their normal stamina has been restored. Fortunately, the strength in their arms also returned. The time of bolting across the battlefield like a gale of fury has passed. Or has it?
Some [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHOCK_UNIT]warriors[/hyperlink] delight in the return of their martial strength, while others miss their increased agility. What did you prefer?

options.text: "My magical talents <mana></mana> may make their haste permanent."
Perform a blood sacrifice to gain the enchantment.
"I prefer my warriors strong, not swift."

happenings.name: Melenis's Kiss
happenings.sub:
All units have a 30% chance of turning slain enemies into Zombies under your control.
These Zombies stay after combat and have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CANNOT_REGENERATE]Cannot Regenerate[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>All units have a 30% chance of turning slain non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] enemies into Zombies under your control that stay after combat.</bullet><bullet>These Zombies have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CANNOT_REGENERATE]Cannot Regenerate[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: Once, an ancient curse created the Undead on another world. Its echo now encroaches from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] and envelops your world.

The eldritch nebula, dubbed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MelenisLoreConcept]Melenis's[/hyperlink] Kiss by seers, imprints a shared dream on the soldiers of your realm. A dream of menacing hunger and endless waking. A promise of unrelenting thralldom at the mercy of your rivals.
Those slain in combat are imperiled by this curse: to serve the masters of those they fight. In undeath.

options.text: "A double-edged sword. My troops must be vigilant."
"They believe I am involved in this? How quaint. How delightful."
"Curse <eventColor>Player</eventColor> and her foul tricks!"

events.label: End
text: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral winds[/hyperlink] finally carry away [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MelenisLoreConcept]Melenis[/hyperlink] Kiss back into the cosmos, where it will surely haunt another world.

Yet its presence undeniably left its stain on your world. Troops who fought loyally for their masters were forced to join the ranks of their sworn enemies. For some Godir, Melenis's Kiss was a blessing. For others, their downfall.
Now you must decide how to deal with the shadowy chaos it left in its wake.

options.text: "My glory <influence></influence> rejects these abominations. They must be destroyed!" <unit></unit>
"These creatures are imperfect. My dark spells <souls></souls> will mend them."
"I've grown quite fond of my involuntary conscripts. They may stay."
Melenis's Kiss did not gift you any Zombies.

happenings.name: Sunstruck Eruptions
happenings.sub:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNSTRUCK_ERUPTIONS_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Volcanic Eruptions[/hyperlink] is active in combat.
Provinces are slowly becoming Desolate.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Provinces turn into Desolate around the world.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNSTRUCK_ERUPTIONS_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Volcanic Eruptions[/hyperlink] active in combat.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: Astrologers warn you that the sun inches towards your world. Every hour, the fiery orb in the heavens seems larger.

They suspect [hyperlink,GLOBAL.YakaLoreConcept]Yaka[/hyperlink], or one of his overconfident acolytes, is performing an improvident ritual. Global temperatures rise until a flashpoint is reached. Volcanoes violently appear across the world, burning lush lands and renewable resources.
Volcanic blaze and ruin wreak havoc in your realm. Can you and your armies withstand the heat?

options.text: "If I can keep a cool head, we won't get burned."
"This wasn't my doing... this time."
"<eventColor>Player</eventColor> will burn for this treachery!"

events.label: End
text: You notice that the days become cooler again, as the sun finally abates its encroachment on your world.

The flaming chaos withdraws as the sun reclaims its usual position in the cosmos. Its warmth is once again comforting instead of scorching. Yet the devastation that the sun caused leaves a smoldering mark on your lands.
Will you invest in the restoration of your lands? Or do you suffer the desolation to gain other boons?

options.text: Reseed <food></food> the desolated wastelands to restore their lush and life.
Extract the secrets of <eventColor>Enchantment</eventColor> from the dying volcanoes.
"I will conquer <influence></influence> this realm, regardless of any wastelands within my domain."
Wastelands do not tarnish your domain.

happenings.name: Ravenous Visitants
happenings.sub:
Astral parasites invade your world!
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ETHEREAL]Ethereal[/hyperlink] Units benefit from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INFINITE_BEING_GROUP]Attunement: Enhancement[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Armies of hostile astral creatures appear across the world.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ETHEREAL]Ethereal[/hyperlink] units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INFINITE_BEING_GROUP]a random positive status effect[/hyperlink] when a spell is cast.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: An impossibly deep bellow heralds the arrival of a colossal creature from the far reaches of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink].

Although intimidating, the Astral Leviathan does not appear hostile. Yet in its wake follow swarms of malicious [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralMonstersLoreConcept]Astral Sea Monsters[/hyperlink], such as <eventColor>enemies</eventColor>. What's worse, the Astral Leviathan's deep song makes ethereal creatures such as these parasites more attuned to the reverberations of magic.
Ravenous parasitic creatures that follow the Astral Leviathan descend upon your realm to feast on life!

events.label: End
text: The Astral Leviathan that circumscribes your world has seemingly lost interest. It drifts away peacefully, after one final bellow.

Within a few heartbeats, the colossus has gone from your sight, floating away with an unlikely haste. Most of the invaders that swarmed your world notice its departure and follow its ethereal current.
The Astral parasites that remain on your world, marooned and severed from their cosmic host, will die off soon.

happenings.name: Blightfall Conjunction
happenings.sub:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLIGHTFALL_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Blightfall Conjunction[/hyperlink] is active in combat.
Cities require more [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLIGHTFALL_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Blightfall Conjunction[/hyperlink] active in combat.</bullet><bullet>Cities lose -5 <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] per <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: Astrologers warn you of the imminent conjunction of <eventColor>Random Nature World</eventColor>, a world of Growth, and <eventColor>Random Shadow World</eventColor>, a world of Decay.
The combined pull on your realm is causing crops to rot as they ripen. The threat of a famine looms. Equally disastrous are the reports of your troops suffering from an unnatural disease.
Finding uncorrupted food to harvest has become a nigh impossible challenge, while your soldiers threaten to succumb to pestilence.

events.label: End
text: The realm is finally permitted respite: the Blightfall Conjunction has ended.

Your famished <eventColor>race</eventColor> are relieved to find an abundance of fresh foods after such a deprivation. Your warriors, full-bellied once again, stand strong and firm, ready at your command.
The realm is healing. Only the most devious would seek to profit from this global disaster.

options.text: Learn the <eventColor>spell</eventColor> spell to curse <evilact></evilact> your enemies with this plague.
Harvest the souls <souls></souls> of those who succumbed to the Blightfall.
Let us leave this age of pestilence behind us.

happenings.name: Colossus Moon
happenings.sub: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COLOSSUS_MOON_UNIT_AUTO_SPELL]Thunder Storms [/hyperlink] are active in combat. Regions around the world turn into Swamps.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COLOSSUS_MOON_UNIT_AUTO_SPELL]Thunder Storms[/hyperlink] active in combat.</bullet><bullet>Regions around the world turn into Swamps.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The full moon draws closer to your world. Its pull on the oceans climbs to unprecedented levels.

This is a moon unlike any you've seen before. It glows like a white-hot steel shield. Soon, salty waves stir with such violence that they wash over beaches and cliffs alike. Storm clouds black as ink form over the seas and deluge the continents, their burdens spilling on the saturated surface of the realm.
The Colossus Moon reigns supreme. Shores cannot contain the seas and thunderstorms flood the lands.

events.label: End
text: The Colossus Moon finally seems satisfied with the destruction it wrought on the world. It has begun to wane.
Scouts confirm your presumptions. Many provinces on the coast have turned into Swamps after being flooded by the torrential barrages that the thunderstorms delivered.
Can you use these new swamps to your benefit? Or will you erase the scars of the thunderstorms?

options.text: Drain new swamps in your domain using earth, wood, and stone. <production></production>
Learn the secrets of <eventColor>Enchantment</eventColor> from the thunderous onslaught.
"The downpour made the lands more fertile. <food></food> My cities will grow."
Swamps never flooded your domain.

happenings.name: Stirring Stone Conjunction
happenings.sub:
Cities gain +100% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income.
All units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SIEGE_BREAKER]Siege Breaker[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Cities gain +100% <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>All units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SIEGE_BREAKER]Siege Breaker[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The conjunction of the <matter></matter> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MateriumConcept]Materium Affinity[/hyperlink] world <eventColor>Random Materium World</eventColor> and the <arcana></arcana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral Affinity[/hyperlink] world <eventColor>Random Astral World</eventColor> was foretold. That prophecy is now fulfilled.

Magical properties seep into rock and stone, making both more compliant and easier to manipulate. However, the augmented stone cannot discern between chisel and battering ram. Masonry that was built to last now gladly yields to the striking sword.
While builders benefit from the malleable stone, defensive structures suddenly easily crumble!

events.label: End
text: As the Stirring Stone conjunction nears its end, stone and earth are magically stirred from their slumber and begin to move.

From within city walls, <eventColor>enemies</eventColor> are trying to break free. Binding these spirits to your service is easily achieved, but their release will cause the obliteration of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.STONE_WALLS]Sentry Nests[/hyperlink] that birthed them.
Will you welcome these stone-faced allies, or shall you bind them within your walls?

options.text: "A simple sleep enchantment <mana></mana> will keep my walls intact."
"Stone bends to my will. One <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> <unit></unit> won't destroy the walls."
"The <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> <unit></unit> are worth more to me than stone walls."
"It's a good thing I don't have any Stone Walls."

happenings.name: Cosmic Winds
happenings.sub:
Deserts spread across your world.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SOLAR_WINDS_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Blinding Sands[/hyperlink] affects combat.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Provinces turn into Deserts around the world.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SOLAR_WINDS_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Blinding Sands[/hyperlink] active in combat.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: From the outer skies above the realm, cosmic winds flagellate the world. Wherever they blow, vegetation is burned or sanded down.
Rivers and lakes dry up. Not even the thickest wall or highest mountain can repel the currents. You are at the mercy of the fickle gales issued by the cosmos.
You can only witness how your domain slowly erodes into a barren desert.

events.label: End
text: Finally, the relentless cosmic winds recede. The world is given a chance to restore life in the barren deserts.

You only vaguely remember what your world used to look like before. Much of what was lush and verdant has been scourged by the dry tempests. There is but one solacing thought: that all your rivals have endured the same sandy ordeal.
Will you advance the desolate realm's restoration? Or have the sandstorms inspired you to develop new tricks.

options.text: Revitalize <mana></mana> the coarse Deserts and revert your provinces to their original terrains.
Learn <eventColor>Enchantment</eventColor> to summon sandstorms in combat.
Sieve your desert's sands to claim treasures <gold></gold> previously locked in earth.
Sand does not blanket any of your lands.

happenings.name: <order></order> Dawn of the Lodestar
happenings.sub:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CH_ORDER_PROPERTY_GROUP]Angelic Potential[/hyperlink] affects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL]Celestial[/hyperlink] units and units with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAITHFUL]Faithful[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ZEAL]Zeal[/hyperlink]
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] spawn armies to attack their targets
All units permanently suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ORDER_INFLUENCE_GROUP]Order Influence[/hyperlink]
happenings.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL]Celestial[/hyperlink] units and units with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAITHFUL]Faithful[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ZEAL]Zeal[/hyperlink] have:+2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept]Status Resistance[/hyperlink]+20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] spawn armies to attack their targets.
For the rest of the game:All units have -2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpiritResistanceConcept]Spirit Protection[/hyperlink].

events.label: Foreshadowing
text: A new light has appeared in the heavens. Only you seem to be able to see its gleam.

Engulfed by the light of this new star, its peace and purpose fill your spirit: this Lodestar will soon reveal itself to the rest of this world. It shall be a new True North for the allies of Order and Zeal. Let all those who serve its tenets bask in its glorious rays and grow stronger.
As a servant of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order[/hyperlink], you are compelled to foster the dawn of this Lodestar. Will you obey your duty?

options.text: "My inner holy fire <mana></mana> will brighten the star when it comes!"
"A fast <food></food> shall empower the Lodestar's presence!"
"I should not interfere with the natural order of the cosmos."

events.label: Beginning
text: The world basks in the warm light of a new rising star, quickly dubbed the Lodestar.

The Lodestar guides those who follow the path of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order[/hyperlink]: The Celestial, the Faithful, and the Zealous. Vassals feel their hearts and spirits bolstered and launch crusades against their Lords' enemies. Faint harmonies of a chorus resonate in the very foundations of the world, causing all who hear it to quiver.
The Lodestar has dawned, and it brightly ushers in an age of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order[/hyperlink] and Zeal.

options.text: "May its dawn nourish my plans."
"What fanatic bolstered the Lodestar's light, I wonder."
"As it is was destined to be."

events.label: End
text: The golden gleam of the Lodestar is slowly fading, and its servants lament its diminishing.
Yet the Lodestar's rays permanently touched the hearts of those who beheld it, leaving a vulnerability in their spirits.
After the dawn comes the setting of the Lodestar. The world has grown slightly darker, and less orderly.

options.text: "The light fades. The memory lasts."
"The truth about <eventColor>Player</eventColor> is finally brought to light!"
"I pray the world reveled in the blessings I orchestrated."

happenings.name: <arcana></arcana> Drifting Ley Lines
happenings.sub:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CH_ASTRAL_PROPERTY_GROUP]Magic Origin Potential[/hyperlink] affects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] units.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellOverchargeConcept]Overcharged[/hyperlink] the first time they are cast each combat.
Units permanently suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASTRAL_INFLUENCE_GROUP]Astral Influence[/hyperlink].
happenings.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] units have:Attacks inflict [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_RESISTANCE]Sundered Resistance[/hyperlink].Grant +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink] in combat.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] are always [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellOverchargeConcept]Overcharged[/hyperlink] the first time they are cast each combat.
For the rest of the game:All units have -2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningResistanceConcept]Lightning Protection[/hyperlink].

events.label: Foreshadowing
text: Something feels off. You feel pulled at. Peeled. An inner resonance is off-key. A shift is imminent.

You invoke your deep [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral[/hyperlink] attunement to divine the origin of the entrancing sensation. The electrifying realization follows soon: a storm between stars flows over the ley lines of this world. The sorcerous channels of the world are about to drift from their arcane positions. You also sense that this drifting will cause magic to become less predictable.
Is this an opportunity? Dare you drive the drifting of the ley lines and summon uncertainty within the world's magic?

options.text: "My curiosity ordains such an enchanting <mana></mana> experiment!"
"My scholars <knowledge></knowledge> will uncover how to further imbalance the ley lines."
"The ley lines must drift on the Astral flows unhindered."

events.label: Beginning
text: The magical coherence of the world is at risk. The ley lines, the fundamental [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral[/hyperlink] alignment, stray from their courses.

A turbulence in the cosmos washes over the deep Astral channels that bind and guide the magic to this world. Your troops are shocked to discover that they have become conduits for lightning magic. Ethereal beings unwittingly amplify magical energies and all spells burst from potency.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral[/hyperlink] tremors ripple through the realms. It is an era in which little is certain, apart from magic growing unpredictable.

options.text: "This world will never be the same again."
"Which power-crazed wizard delivers us this misery?"
"Promising results, so far!"

events.label: End
text: Having strayed far from their original alignments, the drift of the ley lines is slowing down. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral[/hyperlink] stability is re-emerging.
Spells are less volatile, and the empowering tether that ethereal beings shared the Astral energies is severed. Yet the susceptibility to electrifying magics did not dissipate from your troops.
Centuries shall pass before the ley lines' drifting fully halts. Until then, all must suffer the unpredictable shape of magic.

options.text: "My ambitions require stability too, to lay it on the line."
"<eventColor>Player</eventColor>? The <eventColor>Player</eventColor> crossed a line with this plot."
"I will suffer this outcome as an absolute win."

happenings.name: <chaos></chaos> Eye of Fire
happenings.sub:
Demons are empowered by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EYE_OF_FIRE_PROPERTY_GROUP]Demonic Potential[/hyperlink].
Units are affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHAOTIC_INFLUENCE_GROUP]Chaotic Influence[/hyperlink].
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Vassals[/hyperlink] are growing distrustful of their Overlords.
happenings.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIEND]Fiend[/hyperlink] units have:Base attacks have a 30% chance of inflicting a random status effect. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] lose -10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink] per turn and are able to declare war on their overlords when reaching [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept]Tributary[/hyperlink] or lower.
For the rest of the game:All units have -2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireResistanceConcept]Fire Protection[/hyperlink].

events.label: Foreshadowing
text: You are no stranger to nightly visions of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink], yet tonight's imagery offers an eerie clarity. An Eye of Fire calls you.

The Eye of Fire you see in your feverish vision presents itself to you as a gargantuan ring of flames in the sky. Its gaze will cause lesser lords to break oaths, and demons to ravage the realm. You wake up and realize your world is about to be plummeted into Chaos.
You grin. Fueling the imminent bonfires of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink] will deliver maximum pandemonium.

options.text: "My magic <mana></mana> shall fan the flames of Chaos!"
"My serfs <population></population> shall kindle the flames of Chaos!" <evilact></evilact>
"The Eye of Fire will incite sufficient mayhem."

events.label: Beginning
text: A distant world somewhere in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] shifts in front of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObbadothLoreConcept]Obbadoth[/hyperlink]. It is ensnared in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink] World's radiance, forming an ungodly ring of fire in the heavens.

Like a naked Balor eye in the firmament, the Eye of Fire gazes down on your helpless world. Demons and fiends summoned to your world revel in its light, while vassals are driven mad and abandon their oaths and fealty. The Eye's unholy gleam causes the fires on your world to grow, and their flames burn with searing malice.
The entire realm descends into a maddening domain of fiery [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink]. May the odds be in your favor.

options.text: "We will weather this evil storm."
"What madman would reinforce this occurrence?"
"All according to plan."

events.label: End
text: The demon eye in the sky, wreathed in infernal flames, turns away. Perhaps it hungers for another world to consume.
The world is given a chance to heal from its smoldering wounds. Vassals once again turn to their lords for guidance and plead for their forgiveness.
In any case, your people wish and pray that they shall never again be submitted to such an ordeal.

options.text: "Back to my ambitions for this realm."
"<eventColor>Player</eventColor> must answer for their part in this phenomenon."
"That was entertaining."

happenings.name: Toll of Seasons
happenings.sub: Await the spreading mists.
happenings.description: There are ill tales told on <eventColor>this realm</eventColor>, speaking of a thick mist that lays itself upon the land. When it dissipates, villages and entire cities disappear, leaving no trace of their former inhabitants.

events.label: Foreshadowing
text: The city guards of <eventColor>your city</eventColor> bring before you a bedraggled man, accused of sowing panic with <eventColor>your</eventColor> stories of impending doom.

"The mists will come, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>!" <eventColor>Your Hero</eventColor> speaks with terror in <eventColor>your</eventColor> eyes. "They spread from the fields, creep through the cracks in your city walls... and then—swoosh—everyone is gone! Stolen by the Fey!" The man stares into space until <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> takes out a broken <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. "This," <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> yells, shaking <eventColor>your</eventColor> fists, "is all that's left of my <eventColor>Realm</eventColor>."
What will you do with this fool and <eventColor>your</eventColor> far-fetched claims about a <eventColor>Realm</eventColor> lost to the mists?

options.text: Interrogate the man to learn more about the threat from the mists.
Better safe than sorry. Increase the recruitment <unitprod></unitprod> efforts!
Jail the troublemaker for causing public unrest.
Banish the fool, but keep <eventColor>your</eventColor> <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> after mending it.

happenings.name: Dawn of Calamity
happenings.sub: <eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> has been replaced...
happenings.description: It is said that those who lean too far into [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink] risk stirring the bringer of cataclysms, the harbinger of destruction. The end of realms is heralded by a draconic roar...

text: As you ponder the realm, you are suddenly contacted by none other than a <eventColor>Calamity Dragon</eventColor>, who now seems to rule the <eventColor>people</eventColor>.

With a thundering voice, <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor> announces: "Behold the arrival of <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor>, Calamity incarnate! The <eventColor>people</eventColor> have been deemed worthy of my guidance into [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink]. Join me or face your demise!"

It seems <eventColor>the former ruler</eventColor> of the <eventColor>people</eventColor> has been replaced. How could this have happened to <eventColor>the former ruler</eventColor>? Is this a threat... or an opportunity for you?

happenings.name: Day of Judgment
happenings.sub: <eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> has been replaced...
happenings.description: When a realm is in turmoil and no solution seems to be in sight, the divine machinations of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] bring forth a Judge to restore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order[/hyperlink]. The day of judgment has come.

text: Be it near or far, this realm has seen war and strife. As you contemplate this, a new Ruler announces themselves.

"Greetings, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink]. Given the present state of the realm, <eventColor>the former ruler</eventColor> has been divested of their rule until the manifold troubles are settled. In their stead, the mantle of authority over all <eventColor>people</eventColor> has been bestowed upon me, as <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor>. By the sacred powers vested in me, I shall henceforth render judgment upon all who rule here."
"Those who can rule with faith and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order[/hyperlink] have nothing to fear. Soon, I will contact those worthy of redemption."
options: "Finally, a devotee of Order <order></order> such as I!"
"I recognize no authority but my own!" <imperium></imperium>

happenings.name: Fiendish Takeover
happenings.sub: <eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> has been replaced...
happenings.description: The Infernal [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]World[/hyperlink] of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObbadothLoreConcept]Obbadoth[/hyperlink], realm of war and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink], is cause for many a wary tale. The beings who rule Obbadoth promise great powers... to those who can pay the price.

text: As you ponder the realm, you are suddenly contacted by none other than a <eventColor>Balor</eventColor>, who now seems to rule the <eventColor>people</eventColor>.

Before you can demand an explanation, the new <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor> grins. "Mortals and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink]! The Empire of <eventColor>the former ruler</eventColor> is now under new management. Bow to me, the great <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor>, and despair, for the wrath and fury of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObbadothLoreConcept]Obbadoth[/hyperlink] has arrived!" Their grin grows darker as <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor> severs the connection.

It seems <eventColor>the former ruler</eventColor> of the <eventColor>people</eventColor> has been... replaced. How could this have happened to <eventColor>the former ruler</eventColor>? Is this a danger... or an opportunity for you?

happenings.name: Game of Death
happenings.sub: <eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> has been replaced...
happenings.description: As immortal souls, many [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] stop fearing death altogether. A grave mistake, for Death itself is not one to taunt. When you play games with the Reaper, make sure you win... and ask not for whom the bell tolls.

text: During a moment of respite, you suddenly feel a cold chill, as a <eventColor>Reaper</eventColor> appears before you.

The faceless <eventColor>Reaper</eventColor> whispers in a voice both immensely loud and soft as the rustle of dead leaves: "<eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> summoned me. <eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> thought <eventColor>the former ruler</eventColor> could chain me, cheat me, but no chains can hold death itself. <eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> gambled with their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Soul[/hyperlink] and lost. And thus I claim it, and the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Souls[/hyperlink] of the <eventColor>people</eventColor>. I have no name... but you may call me <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor>."
<eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> of the <eventColor>people</eventColor> has lost a game with <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor> and has been... supplanted.

happenings.name: Honor and Intrigue
happenings.sub: The <eventColor>people</eventColor> have a new <eventColor>ruler</eventColor>...
happenings.description: Even the Council of a powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] is not safe from politics and intrigue. Many sycophants prey on a Ruler's weakest moment to claim power through any means necessary.

text: <eventColor>The former ruler</eventColor> has recently retreated to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept]Astral Void[/hyperlink]. In their absence, <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor> introduces themselves.

"Well met. Our great <eventColor>the former ruler</eventColor> is currently... indisposed, and whilst we investigate their absence, the weight of our proud [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] has fallen onto my shoulders. Rest assured, we will find the one responsible for the fate of our grand [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink], and justice will be served."
It is not abnormal for a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] to temporarily retreat into the Void. For someone to rule in their temporary absence, however, is certainly... unique.

happenings.name: Voice of the People
happenings.sub: Unrest brews within the Empire of <eventColor>the targeted ruler</eventColor>...
happenings.description: When times are dire and tyrants rule, from the people a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AscendedChampLoreConcept]Champion[/hyperlink] will ascend to take the throne and lead them to a greater tomorrow... Unless said tyrant stops them.

text: Too long the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] of <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor> has been at unrest. Now, rumors of a rebellion reach your court.

Any dissent was met with severe punishment from <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor>, but that only seems to have stirred the flames within. Recently, however, the loudest voice of the <eventColor>people</eventColor> has disappeared, rumored to have fled to greener pastures.
Unrest rumbles within the Empire of <eventColor>the new ruler</eventColor>. A threat to be dealt with... or an opportunity for you?

happenings.name: Age of Death
happenings.sub: The Age of Death has arisen...
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>All non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] receive 50% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink] when healed.</bullet><bullet>In combat with the Prophet's armies, all non-friendly units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AGE_OF_DEATH_WIGHTBORN_CURSE_PROPERTY]Curse of Servitude[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The Prophet gains +20 <souls></souls> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulConcept]Souls[/hyperlink] per turn.</bullet></bulletlist>The ruler that foresaw the Vision of Ruin and brought about this age is the Prophet.

happenings.name: Age of Magic
happenings.sub: The Age of Magic has dawned...
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>All rulers may cast an additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] each <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] in combat.</bullet><bullet>The ruler that foresaw the Vision of Ruin may cast [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] for -50% less <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink] and <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

happenings.name: Blood Moon
happenings.sub: The sky darkens into scarlet. The Blood Moon eclipses the light of the sun.
happenings.description: For the next 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] Vampires:<bulletlist><bullet>Don't suffer from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNLIGHT_WEAKNESS]Sunlight Weakness[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] regeneration on the World Map.</bullet><bullet>Gain +20% damage.</bullet><bullet>Gain +2 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The sky darkens into scarlet. The Blood Moon, summoned by <eventColor>Blood Moon Player</eventColor>, eclipses the light of the sun.

The moon bleeds through an open wound, staining the sky crimson. Animals flee to hide, villagers bar their doors, and the creatures of the dusk rejoice in its glow. For the night is red and ruled by horrors.
During its eclipse, the Blood Moon empowers all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept]Vampires[/hyperlink] and allows them to roam freely throughout the world.

options.text: Prepare for the red night.

events.label: End
text: The Blood Moon wanes, and the fear of light returns to those who bask in darkness.

The sun rises behind the fading moon, restoring color to the world. Its rays breathe life into the meadows and kindle hope in weary hearts. The creatures of the dusk retreat to their lairs, sheltered by the shadows within them.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept]Vampires[/hyperlink] are no longer empowered by the Blood Moon and once again suffer the consequences of walking in the light of day.

options.text: Bid farewell to the red night.

happenings.name: Warped Seasons
happenings.sub: It is spring time. During this season:
happenings.description: The seasons are unusually potent on this realm, causing constant change and turmoil.

happenings.name: The Cursed Gold
happenings.sub: The light of the golden ring shines upon the gilded skulls that guard the map to the legendary treasure.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Armies of gilded skulls can be found throughout the realm, guarding the clues to My'dhas' treasure.</bullet><bullet>After 12 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], the eclipse will end and the clues will fade from reach.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The moon of the realm eclipses the sun, and the emerging beams of light mark the location of an ancient forgotten treasure: the cursed gold of My'dhas.

Legends tell of a great lost hoard, of riches so dazzling that the very seas shone with the reflection of its gold. It is said that the treasure was what crowned My'dhas as the God of Wealth, and also the cause of his imprisonment within a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VaultsphereLoreConcept]Vaultsphere[/hyperlink]. The treasure is said to be cursed, for it has taken the life of anyone who has sought it.
The legend says: "When fire turns hollow, the light of the golden ring will shine upon the gilded skulls that guard the map."

options.text: "A golden opportunity indeed."

events.label: End
text: The moon begins to move past the sun and the eclipse comes to an end, making it impossible to find the clues leading to the legendary treasure.

For those who do not know the location of the Cursed Gold, the bounty becomes a legend once more, to be told until the next eclipse. But for those who know where the X marks the spot, the treasure is still within reach. If they dare to claim it...
Treasure hunters return home empty-handed. It may be a good opportunity to recruit experienced sailors.

options.text: Leave them searching for treasures they will never find.
Lure them <influence></influence> into your ranks <unit></unit> with promises of adventures to be had and bounties to discover.
Offer them your <eventColor>Object</eventColor> to train your new armies. <unitprod></unitprod>
Promote <influence></influence> the stories between your ranks, let your renown <renown></renown> grow.
Silence <unhappiness></unhappiness> the stories. The longer it takes them to find out, the better. <influence></influence>

happenings.name: The Nevermoor
happenings.sub: The Nevermoor and its Haunted Armada are raiding the seas.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The Nevermoor sails the seas. Defeat its captain to end this Happening and earn a great reward.</bullet><bullet>The Haunted Armada has risen, affecting all water sectors and filling the seas with ghost ships.</bullet><bullet>Defeating ghost ship armies will grant rewards and an advantage against the Nevermoor fleet.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The sky turns black, darkened, not by clouds, but by a storm of souls. It is the legend of the Nevermoor.

You can hear a captain cry: "Bear to port me boys! Haul away and run! The Nevermoor has come for our souls and the Allfather knows we are outgunned." The cursed caravel is an old tale from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink], of a spectral captain and their Haunter Armada. A tale that has turn into a terrifying reality, pillaging and attacking any vessel on sight in this realm.
Ghost ships now roam the waters, laden with treasures and the secrets of how the defiled fleet came to be... and perhaps how it might be brought low.

options.text: "In a calm sea, everybody is a captain."

events.label: End
text: The Nevermoor vanishes, and with it, the storm of souls that followed in its wake.

The sunken ships and drowned souls descend once more to the bottom of the sea, and the dark clouds begin to disperse. It seems the Nevermoor and its fleet have had their fill of pillaging, looting, and plundering.
The seas are no longer haunted by the Haunted Armada, and the souls of the drowned rest at the bottom of the ocean.

options.text: Let the Nevermoor become a legend once more.
Call <mana></mana> upon those who still linger. <unit></unit>
Hire <gold></gold> priests to lay those souls to rest. <goodact></goodact>
Keep the heart to become the captain of the new Nevermoor. <artifact></artifact>
Destroy the heart and absorb its power. <xp></xp> <souls></souls>
Destroy the heart and free the drowned souls. <goodact></goodact> <mana></mana>

happenings.name: Approaching Doom
happenings.sub: Something is draining the resources from the land, and soon all production on it will be reduced by 40%.
happenings.description: In 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], land [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] will reduce their production by 40%.

events.label: Prelude
text: You sense a disturbance in the magic flows. Something is disrupting the ley lines of the realm.

You cannot figure out yet what it is, but something is draining the realm. Soon the crops will wither and mana crystals will crumble, diminishing your resources. Strangely, for some reason, the seas do not seem to be affected by this phenomenon.
If you do not wish to see your empire perish, you should find other sources of resources or prepare for scarcity.

events.label: Beginning
text: Just as you predicted, the crops are perishing and the mana crystals are cracking... something is draining the life from the land.

Following the trail of energy, you have found the culprit: a radiant [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.PEARLTIDE_DOME]Pearltide Dome[/hyperlink]. The structure is leeching the life of the realm. Whatever is happening within it, you must put a stop to it if the world is to be restored.

Yet while valleys and mountains wither, the seascape remains untouched. Some of the energy seems to accumulate within [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.PEARL_NODE]Pearl Reefs[/hyperlink], nourishing the surrounding waters.

events.label: End
text: Life returns to the land. Crops begin to grow once more, and the realm regains its natural balance.

The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.PEARLTIDE_DOME]Pearltide Dome[/hyperlink] has stabilized, gathering enough energy to fulfill its mysterious purpose. Whatever created this effect still lingers, but it no longer pose a threat to the realm. Your attention now turns to your empire and how to best restore it.
What measures will you take after this catastrophe?

options.text: "The natural cycle has been restored. We must not interfere with it."
Infuse <mana></mana> your crops with energy so they may flourish <food></food> once more.
Focus <influence></influence> on the well being of your population. <happiness></happiness>
Return the energy to the land, restoring the crops <food></food> from your empire.
Force the energy to crystallize. <mana></mana>

happenings.name: Brume on the Water
happenings.sub: Some water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are affected by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BRUME_ON_THE_WATER]Brume on the Water[/hyperlink], where treasures and monstrous figures lurk.
happenings.description: Some water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are affected by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BRUME_ON_THE_WATER]Brume on the Water[/hyperlink]. In them, monstrous figures lurk around [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.FLOATSOAM_PICKUP]Flotsam[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.LUMINOUS_WAVES_UNGUARDED]Luminous Waves[/hyperlink].

events.label: Beginning
text: A dense brume has settled over the ocean, and countless ships have vanished within it.

No vessel that has ventured into the fog has ever returned. Only the stories have made it back to port; stories of monstrous figures lurking in the mist, guarding vast treasures and waters overflowing with mana. Whether you choose to believe such stories is up to you. But the disappearance of so many ships is unsettling beyond doubt.
This mystery haunts the seas, and its answer can only be found among the treasures concealed within the brume

events.label: End
text: The brume has receded, and with it, the beings that dwelled within.

Like a heavy shroud, the fog has sunk into the deepest reaches of the ocean, taking its horrors with it. Your forces were unable to find enough clues to determine what these creatures sought, but whatever their purpose, their threat has passed.
One can only hope that whatever drew them here has now come to an end.

options.text: Let the memory of the brume fade.
Redirect your resources <structureprod></structureprod> to new troops <unitprod></unitprod>, you will not rely on luck alone.
Hire <gold></gold> eldritch experts to research <knowledge></knowledge> the event.
Infuse <mana></mana> yourself with the forbidden power of the monsters.

happenings.name: Frozen Seas
happenings.sub:
The seas freeze, affected by a Whiteout.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.LARGE_CREATURE_PICKUP]Large Creature Cage[/hyperlink] guarded by Hoarfrost Mantas spawn all over these frozen seas.
After 8 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], the ice will melt, drowning any unit unable to swim or embark.
happenings.description: Water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are affected by a Whiteout, allowing your troops to walk through them.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.LARGE_CREATURE_PICKUP]Large Creature Cage[/hyperlink] guarded by Hoarfrost Mantas spawn all over these frozen seas.After 8 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], the ice will melt, and any unit unable to swim or embark will immediately drown.

events.label: Beginning
text: A bone-chilling cold sweeps across the realm, freezing the seas and trapping countless victims beneath their solid waves.

The Hoarfrost Mantas gather once again for their seasonal feeding ritual, freezing the waters with their icy breath. Schools of these primordial creatures flock around their immobilized prey, devouring their essence in a ravenous frenzy.
Those unfortunate souls would surely be grateful to anyone who rescued them, owing their lives and their service to their savior.

events.label: Warning
text: The manta schools have nearly sated their hunger, and the ice begins to crack.
The thick sheet of ice that allowed your armies to march across the sea is melting away. Anyone unable to swim will soon be claimed by the depths.
The waters will flow again in no time.

events.label: End
text: The temperature begins to rise, shattering the sheets of ice that blanketed the sea.

The schools of Hoarfrost Mantas disperse, leaving their half-frozen victims to sink beneath the waves. Yet some fragments of ice seem to have undergone a magical transformation, darkening in color and remaining locked in a state of perpetual frost.
Your troops have recovered one of these frost gems. What will you do with it?

options.text: You have no interest in such magic.
Forge <bindingfragments></bindingfragments> it into a ring. <item></item>
Infuse <mana></mana> its essence into a spell.
Build <structureprod></structureprod> an artifact to use the gem as a power source. <mana></mana>
Use the gem to attract and raise <food></food> your own Hoarfrost Mantas.

happenings.name: Lamenters' Call
happenings.sub:
Units starting their turn on water gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink], while units starting their turn on land lose it.
Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] lose [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ACCURSED_LAMENTER]Accursed Lamenters[/hyperlink] sing over [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.WRECKAGE_PICKUP]Galleon Wreckages[/hyperlink]; slaying them rewards [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] to all your cities.
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Units that start their turn on water provinces gain +5 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Units that start their turn on land provinces lose -5 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] lose <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] for the duration of the Happening.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ACCURSED_LAMENTER]Accursed Lamenters[/hyperlink] sing over [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.WRECKAGE_PICKUP]Galleon Wreckages[/hyperlink]; slaying them rewards <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] to all your cities.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: A mournful song fills the air, and a great sorrow washes over you.

An irresistible urge to venture out to sea and hear it up close takes hold of you. The song cannot break your will, but not everyone possesses your resolve. Ships and boats sail out to sea, seeking the melody that makes them yearn for all they once loved.
The lamenters are singing in a realm-wide chorus, bringing doom to every soul that hears their tune.

options.text: "Magic and steel will silence their song."

events.label: End
text: The song of the accursed fiends has ceased, and the wrecks sink into the sea with the souls of the drowned.

The realm-wide choir of lamenters has ceased its song, and the weight upon your soul fades away. A fleeting sense of relief fills you, but the melody continues to gnaw at your mind. Their words echo: "Oh my sailor, you look paler, fear no fire or frost; For my brave, beneath the waves, we hold all you've lost."
The power and rhythm of the song still linger within you. A nuisance, or perhaps an opportunity.

options.text: Let the song fade.
Compose <knowledge></knowledge> a spell with the accursed melody.
Hire <gold></gold> bards to compose a new song to forget <happiness></happiness> the accursed requiem.

happenings.name: Light of the Depths
happenings.sub: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] of the seas shine with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIGHT_OF_THE_DEPTHS]Light of the Depths[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: Water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are affected by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIGHT_OF_THE_DEPTHS]Light of the Depths[/hyperlink].

events.label: Beginning
text: Seas and underground lakes begin to glow throughout the realm. Old sailors speak of an ancient legend, a mysterious algae said to rise from the depths.

From the deepest ocean trenches, hundreds of luminous strands begin to emerge. At first, their glow is faint, unable to illuminate the vastness of the sea. But as more appear, the waters are transformed into a dazzling spectacle of light and energy. These algae do not merely fill the sea with radiance; they fill them with power.
Charged with an unknown magic, the seaweed imbues everything it touches with its energy. Though its origin remains a mystery, your empire could prosper greatly from its discovery.

events.label: End
text: With the coming of the new moon, the luminous algae begin to sink back. Yet a bewitched and mysterious song seems to hold some of them fast.

A few strands remain behind, swaying with the tides and the inhuman melody. You know this song of sorrow and despair, it is the dirge of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ACCURSED_LAMENTER]Accursed Lamenter[/hyperlink]. Their voices seem to be transforming the algae, draining its color and causing it to gleam accursed energy.
The fiends appear intent on using the algae for their own ends. Perhaps you could do the same.

options.text: "It is unwise to meddle in the affairs of the damned."
Sing the canticle <mana></mana> of the damned, adding your own stanza.
Set an ambush <unitprod></unitprod> to capture one of the creatures. <unit></unit>
Task your tideweavers <knowledge></knowledge> with mastering the cultivation of this algae.
Compose <influence></influence> a requiem with the harmony of the dirge.

happenings.name: Marine Festival
happenings.sub:
Water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] increase their income by 50%.
The cost of new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] is halved.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EMBARKED_PENALTY]Embarked[/hyperlink] units reduced their upkeep by 50%.
happenings.description: During 8 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] going through water increase their income by 50%.</bullet><bullet>The cost of new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] is halved.</bullet><bullet>Upkeep of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EMBARKED_PENALTY]Embarked[/hyperlink] units is reduced by 50%.</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: You have been invited to the Marine Festival, hosted by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarinusLoreConcept]Silver Seas Company[/hyperlink].

In the heart of the ocean lies a floating harbor unlike any other: dozens of ships anchored side by side and linked by wooden piers. Renowned sailing vessels from across the realm gather here, creating a temporary city upon the waves; home to merchants, entertainers, mercenaries, and seafarers of every kind. Maritime trade flourishes as the fair draws visitors from every corner of the realm.
The event presents an excellent investment opportunity. How will you respond to the invitation?

options.text: "Not all that glitters is gold."
Send your agents <influence></influence> to forge new commercial ties.
Send your ships <unitprod></unitprod> to participate in the festival and earn profits.

events.label: End
text: The maritime fair has come to an end, though your fleet never took part in it.

For a few short moons, this festival was the beating heart of the sea. Countless crews found promising new deckhands, while merchants and traders filled their coffers. Once again, the fair proved a resounding success.
Maritime trade has returned to normal.

options.text: Return to sail the seas.
Use the treaties to open a new Trade Route. <traderoutetoken></traderoutetoken>
Use the treaties to improve relations with Free Cities. <allegiance></allegiance>
Leverage your influence <influence></influence> as the host to broker a deal benefiting both parts. <traderoutetoken></traderoutetoken> <allegiance></allegiance>
Cash the notes in for gold. <gold></gold>
Cash the notes in for mana. <mana></mana>
Hold the notes <influence></influence> and collect the interest. <gold></gold> <mana></mana>

happenings.name: Mating Season
happenings.sub: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.WATER_EGG_PICKUP_GUARDED]Abandoned Egg Clusters[/hyperlink] fill the seas, stolen from the now peaceful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SPAWNING_SHOAL]Spawning Shoals[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SPAWNING_SHOAL]Spawning Shoals[/hyperlink] are neutral to players. </bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.WATER_EGG_PICKUP_GUARDED]Abandoned Egg Clusters[/hyperlink] spawn in water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

events.label: Beginning
text: The mating season of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.NIMU_UNIT]Nimu[/hyperlink] and other marine species has arrived, and the seas ring with courtship songs and breeding rituals.

Various subspecies of Nimu rise to the surface, their shells adorned with beautiful corals to attract a mate. The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SPAWNING_SHOAL]Spawning Shoals[/hyperlink] are now peaceful nesting grounds, tended by devoted parents. Yet other creatures seize the opportunity to steal the eggs, using them as a rich source of nourishment.

The sea is filled with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.WATER_EGG_PICKUP_GUARDED]Abandoned Egg Clusters[/hyperlink], guarded by predators competing for their tasty prize. Perhaps you could offer these marine creatures a better fate.

events.label: End
text: Mating season has come to an end, and the aquatic species once again gather around the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SPAWNING_SHOAL]Spawning Shoals[/hyperlink].

The nests are now filled with hungry hatchlings waiting to be fed. And so, inexperienced but determined parents take to the hunt in great numbers, attacking any vessel they encounter in search of food or to defend their territory.
All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PICKUPS.WATER_EGG_PICKUP_GUARDED]Abandoned Egg Clusters[/hyperlink] have either hatched or been devoured by predators. And now, an opportunity presents itself.

options.text: Better to use your resources elsewhere.
Feed <food></food> the Spawning Shoals.
Drill <unitprod></unitprod> your new aquatic army in naval warfare. <xp></xp>
Release <unit></unit> the animals you saved. <goodact></goodact>

happenings.name: Mutiny!
happenings.sub: A mutiny has broken out against the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingConcept]Free Captains[/hyperlink]. Bounties have been posted for every pirate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestation[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingConcept]Free Captain[/hyperlink].
happenings.description: Bounties have been posted for every pirate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestation[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingConcept]Free Captain[/hyperlink].

events.label: Beginning
text: To arms! Numerous pirate crews have risen in rebellion against the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingConcept]Free Captain[/hyperlink].

The great pirate lords have wasted no time in responding, generous bounties have been posted for the heads of the mutineers. The rebels have answered in kind, placing prices on the heads of the pirate captains. Loyalties are put to the test in this bidding war, one that drenches the seas in ember dust and blood.
It is a great opportunity for those whose only allegiance is to gold.

events.label: End
text: The pirate feud has come to an end, and the accounts have been settled in blood and gold.

The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingConcept]Free Captain[/hyperlink] has reached agreements with the surviving crews to preserve the status quo: A larger share of the spoils, the right to sail under their own banner, promotions... Whatever the terms, the conflict has left behind cargo to be sold and crews to be hired by the highest bidder.
Some of the wares and free pirates catch your eye.

options.text: Nothing here is worth the gold.
<gold></gold> "The <eventColor>Crew Name</eventColor> <eventColor>Crew Name2</eventColor> crew is fine steel for my ships." <unit></unit>
<gold></gold> "A fiery addition to my arsenal." <item></item>
Take advantage of the opportunity to strike a deal with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingConcept]Free Captain[/hyperlink]. <allegiance></allegiance>
Take advantage of the opportunity to strike a deal with the mutineers.

happenings.name: Paragon of the Seas
happenings.sub: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] with more water provinces will receive a primordial boon!
happenings.description: After <eventColor>OCEANIC_PARAGON_TURNS_LEFT</eventColor> <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] with more water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] will receive the primordial boon of the seas.

events.label: Beginning
text: Upon the open sea, the waters themselves begin to stir. Powerful currents whirl together, taking the shape of a colossal and primordial figure.

Its voice is as deep as the ocean and as mighty as a tidal wave: "Uncertain times draw near, Godir. The elements are out of balance, and the seas of this realm seek a new Paragon. Prove yourselves worthy of such a boon. During this lunar phase, grow with the tides, become one with the water, and the might of the sea shall be yours."
The primordial being fades away in the waves, and its water crashes upon the shores bearing a promise of power.

events.label: End
text: When the appointed time of the primordial being comes to an end, its continental form reappears offshore.

Born from waves and seafoam, its voice proclaims the victor of the divine contest: "Let it be known to all who sail the waters that today the seas of the realm have a new champion. Remember the name of <eventColor>Winner</eventColor>, Paragon of the Seas, for they now command our strength."
The waves of the primordial crash upon the shores of the realm with a warning: a Godir has gained great power.

options.text: The primordial turns toward <eventColor>your city</eventColor>, addressing you directly.
Suddenly, the primordial turns toward <eventColor>your city</eventColor>, addressing you directly.
Let the waves crash on the shore, they cannot reach you.
Call <influence></influence> your people to arms <unitprod></unitprod>, you must be ready.
Craft <mana></mana> magical protections for your troops.

events.label: The winner's prize
text: The towering primordial speaks again, its voice thundering across the realm:
